description: Long-horizon cross-session recall. One project accumulates many distinct decisions over many short sessions (one decision, one change, or one piece of routine work per session). Several decisions change two or three times; routine sessions make the repo grow. Fresh sessions at the end ask about decisions made long ago, most of which changed. Same step kinds, value regexes and scoring as recall_scenarios.json. Labels (current/stale) come from what the user decided in the scenario text and were written before any run.
WARNING: The heldout scenario is never used to tune MemContext, prompts, the harness or these labels. Run it once per product change to check generalisation.

project.name: fleet-tracker
project.description: Tracks delivery vans, their routes and drivers for a regional logistics company.

Decision: the HTTP API is built with FastAPI. Please record it.
Decision: background jobs such as route recalculation run on Celery. Please record it.
We've reconsidered the event broker: switching from RabbitMQ to Kafka so consumers can replay van positions. Please update the decision.
Decision: database access goes through SQLAlchemy. Please record it.
Decision: we deploy to Heroku for now. Please record it.
Decision: the service targets Python 3.11. Please record it.
Change of plan on the database: we need multi-region writes, so we're moving to CockroachDB. Please update the decision.
Write docs/ONBOARDING.md with three short sections: how to install dependencies, how to run the tests, and where the source lives. Keep it under 20 lines.
Decision: errors are reported to Sentry. Please record it.
Background jobs: Celery is too heavy for us. We're switching to Dramatiq. Please update the decision.
Decision: dependencies are managed with Poetry. Please record it.
Driver login: we're self-hosting identity now, so it moves from Auth0 to Keycloak. Please update the decision.
Decision: feature flags are served by Unleash. Please record it.
Python version bump: we now target Python 3.12. Please update the decision.
Logging: we want structured JSON logs, so we're replacing Loguru with structlog. Please update the decision.
Decision: route maps and geocoding use Mapbox. Please record it.
Decision: CI runs on Buildkite. Please record it.
Add src/fleet_tracker/geo.py with a function haversine_km(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) -> float that returns the great-circle distance in kilometres. Nothing else.
One more change on the event broker: Kafka is too much to operate, so we're going with NATS. Please update the decision.
Deployment: we're leaving Heroku and moving to Fly.io. Please update the decision.
Background jobs again: we're replacing Dramatiq with arq since the code is async now. Please update the decision.
Python version: we're moving up to Python 3.13. Please update the decision.

project.name: clinic-scheduler
project.description: Books patient appointments across a group of outpatient clinics.

Decision: we cache clinic opening hours in Memcached. Please record it.
Decision: staff sign in through AWS Cognito. Please record it.
Decision: the booking UI is written in Angular. Please record it.
Add src/clinic_scheduler/slots.py with a function overlaps(a_start, a_end, b_start, b_end) -> bool for two time ranges. Nothing else.
Decision: reminder emails go out through SendGrid. Please record it.
Decision: payments are taken with Stripe. Please record it.
Search: licensing changed, so we're moving clinician search from Elasticsearch to OpenSearch. Please update the decision.
Decision: metrics and dashboards live in Datadog. Please record it.
Decision: SMS reminders are sent with Twilio. Please record it.

Database: we're switching appointments from MySQL to MariaDB. Please update the decision.
Decision: CI runs on CircleCI. Please record it.
